name: walle-companion-app
description: WALL-E Innovation Day — companion/control app for the ESP32-C3 robot. Implements WALL-E Robot API v1.

scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.typecheck:android: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm --prefix android typecheck 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
